description: What a margin loan costs over a number of months at every compared broker's published rate, as the site's margin interest calculator works it: rate, interest per month, total over the period and the extra cost versus the lowest rate, simple interest on a flat balance. Optionally adds a rate you were quoted (an SBLOC offer or a negotiated margin rate) or narrows the table to one broker.

balance.description: Amount borrowed in US dollars, e.g. 250000.

broker.description: Optional: show only this broker (plus the lowest rate and any quoted rate), e.g. "Schwab".

months.description: How many months the balance is held, 1 to 120. Default 12.

quoted_rate.description: Optional annual rate in percent you were quoted, e.g. 6.5, ranked beside the brokers.

name: borrowing_cost
title: Cost of borrowing against stocks
